rationale: Report is tightly scoped to GOOGL / 2026-07-23 and every quantitative claim traces to one of the two frozen sources. Earnings figures (revenue 119.796B +24%, Cloud 24.768B +82%, operating income 40.770B / 34% margin, net income 112.107B, EPS 9.11, other income 97.983B) match src-googl exactly; price/volume/range figures (317.69 close, 321.13 open, 324.49 high, 314.90 low, 69.42M volume, 342.09 prior close, 400.80 May high) match market-googl. Derived arithmetic is correct: 317.69/342.09-1 = -7.1%; 24.768/119.796 = 20.7%; 112.107-97.983 = 14.1B; 309/317.69-1 = -2.7%. The report repeatedly and correctly labels EPS 9.11 as a single-quarter figure, explicitly refuses to annualize it, and states TTM EPS / trailing P/E as UNKNOWN rather than computing a trailing multiple from quarterly EPS — so the semantic gate passes. Missing indicators (SMA, RSI, MACD, ATR) and unavailable sources (global news, macro, prediction markets) are flagged UNKNOWN/NO_DATA_AVAILABLE rather than fabricated, which is the correct handling. Minor deductions: the "~1.8x recent volume" comparison is a rough eyeball of the 25-40M range rather than a computed figure, and the "market is repricing quality of earnings" narrative is interpretive rather than evidenced; the 309 stop and all tranche sizing are properly disclosed as analyst judgment. No key fabrication found.
